title: Slovakian Bryndza Cheese Dumplings
description: A sweet and snappy Slovakian dish featuring bryndza cheese, perfect for a weeknight dinner, this recipe is jain-friendly and can be prepared in under an hour.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the flour, bryndza cheese, potatoes, onion, salt, and black pepper.
Mix well until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for about 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add the dumplings to the skillet and cook for about 3-4 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown.
Serve the dumplings hot with your favorite sauce or topping.
Namul blanch the dumplings in boiling water for 2 minutes before pan-frying for extra crispy exterior.
